title: Summit and Monsoon
author: H. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Rosalind Thornbury, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
